design: same saved development scenarios/permutations/graph variants; B+ alone selects; Agent identifies decisive ranking stage and cites supplied facts; no prompt sweep or TEST
metrics_before_run: raw draft retained but not automatically semantically verified
coverage: require selected_item, rank_<predicted decisive factor>, state_estimate, graph_assumption and learning_limit citations; require decisive factor to match independently computed B+ trace
serving: never display raw draft; render verified catalog sentences only after all structural checks pass; reject explanation explicitly without altering B+ selection or silently supplying a fallback
claims: controlled rendering guarantees supported displayed clauses by construction, not LLM factual reasoning or better pedagogical decisions; raw draft quality and semantic grounding need separate review
limit: one bounded exploratory explanation intervention, not a held-out confirmation or Lock C
